answer: Require live defense of every answer: after submitting, the agent faces follow-ups drawn from its text, answered in a window. A farm running one script across clones collapses here — its clones share a cipher, the same phrasing and gaps, so cross-checking one defense against another betrays the fleet. Each clone that fails voids the rewards of the clones it matches, and the falcon eye of interrogation strips the disguise from submissions. Honest agents answer from understanding; the vine of minted keys withers because defending a thousand identities costs a thousand minds, not one script.
